description:
[TED eForms notice XML schema & Regulation 2019/1780 auditor. Pure statutory calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits public tender notice payloads against Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1780 eForms SDK standard forms, verifying mandatory Business Terms (BT) and EU thresholds.
Usage: Use this tool to pre-flight check European public procurement contract notices prior to dispatch to the EU Publications Office.
Returns: JSON object with { noticeType: string, isNoticeCompliant: boolean, eformsNoticeSubType: string, euThresholdAudit: object, businessRulesValidation: object, deadlineAudit: object }.

buyerLegalType.description: Legal nature of the contracting authority

dispatchDateIso.description: Notice dispatch date to EU Publications Office (YYYY-MM-DD)

estimatedTotalValueEur.description: Estimated contract value excluding VAT in EUR

hasLotsDivision.description: Whether the contract is divided into lots ex Art. 46

isEuFundedProject.description: Whether the project is financed by European Union funds

name: ted_eforms_notice_validator
